status: preview only - not wired into any runtime; going live needs Ichsan's approval

logical_frame.note: unchanged contract; motion data, wear strips, head/Emosi anchors all live in this space

overflow_canvas.math: canvas_x = x + 32, canvas_y = y + 16; legacy 64x112 crop = canvas rows 16..127, cols 32..95
overflow_canvas.why: bbox of all 62 motions in logical px is x -7..70, y 29..111 (faint/get_up lose up to 99 px at 64x112, tent_sleep 66, bench_sleep 63); kneel NE/NW shins reach row 105, sit_floor row 101

sprite_space.draw_with: the frame's pelvis matrix (same transform the rig gives the pelvis part; RotSprite at non-90 angles, exact at 0/90/180/270)
sprite_space.authored_rows: pelvis-local (rest space). Floor poses are drawn for a canonical pelvis drop REF_DY so soles/knees/buttocks touch row 100 when pelvis.y == REF_DY

draw_slot: first entry of the main draw group (where the legs are today in every view); rig parts leg_far_upper/lower and leg_near_upper/lower are not drawn and their joint balls are removed; pelvis, torso, arms, head draw over the sprite unchanged; pinhole_fill runs after compositing
mirror_rule: sw = mirror(se) and nw = mirror(ne) (x -> 63-x) unless a view is drawn on its own (crouch NW is: the NW arm crosses the chest, so the knee is drawn compact). All 4 views ship as separate files; the runtime never mirrors.

outfits.pants: skin + pants ramp + shoe keys; pairs with NEW art/wear/trousers_a(_f).png (official trousers + crotch notch closed + 1px leg-edge skin sliver covered + female NE stray waist pixel removed) on pelvis/torso/legs
outfits.skirt: skin legs + shoe keys + the skirt continuation below the pelvis; pairs with NEW art/wear/skirt_a(_f).png on pelvis/torso instead of trousers

stand.use: skirt outfit only, frames with all leg angles 0; other outfits keep rig legs

walk.status: not drawn on purpose - rig legs with v2 joints (see REPORT.md walk evaluation)

sit_chair.status: drawn (round 2: NE/NW thigh-forward volume + far shin under the seat)

sit_long.status: drawn (round 2) - legs out on the floor, leaning back

crouch.status: drawn (round 2: NE/NW redrawn, knee + shin + foot instead of a blob; NW drawn separately)

kneel.status: drawn (round 2) - thighs upright, knees on the floor, shins back

lie_curl.status: drawn (overflow canvas; = the sit_chair sprite, rotated with the pelvis)

selection_rule.inputs: frame's resolved pose (screen space): pa = pelvis.a, dy = pelvis.y, thigh = max |leg_*_upper.a|, knee = max |leg_*_lower.a|
order: |pa| >= 60 -> lie_curl if knee >= 60 or thigh >= 40, else lie_straight
dy >= 12 and knee >= 120 and thigh >= 55 -> crouch
dy >= 6 and thigh >= 50 and knee >= 50 -> sit_chair
dy >= 6 and thigh >= 60 and knee < 50 -> sit_long
outfit == skirt and every leg angle == 0 -> stand

wear.skirt_a.png / skirt_a_f.png: art/wear/, 256x112 SE|SW|NE|NW, skirt top on pelvis/torso (open bottom, closed notch)
wear.trousers_a.png / trousers_a_f.png: art/wear/, 256x112 SE|SW|NE|NW, official trousers with 3 fixes (see outfits.pants)

baked_base_packages.what: official pixels unchanged; v2 leg slice + pivots baked into masks, capRadius 0

head_emosi: head pixels and head matrix identical to live in every QA frame (qa.json)

joints_v4.status: PREVIEW R3 (2026-11-14), not live; primary path for custom motions. Option A lower sprites (poses/files above) = optional fallback only.
joints_v4.built_on: rt joint_mode v2 (fixSlice, KNEE_Y 90, HIP_Y 0, buildBalls, pinholeFill)

deltoid_to_torso.rule: mask px owned by the upper arm with y <= pivot.y + SH_DY -> torso

prep.pivots: artist pivots kept (shoulder, elbow, hip); knee = v2 (shin-run centre, KNEE_Y)

render_passes: raise_front: near arm drawn over head pixels when outward angle >= 120 (still behind torso)
active zone from ID render: moved parts + parent within 7.5px of moved joints; head/hair/face + rest-art exemptions never written
dejag: 1px dents filled (fill colour of neighbour), 1px outline teeth cleared
edge repair: exposed fill -> family outline (skin K7, P1-3 -> P4, C1-3 -> C4), never thickening (no 2x2, keeps a fill neighbour)
